verdict.rationale: The docs show a plugin system that can add runtime gameplay features, extend the Editor, and be enabled per project (unreal-docs-5, unreal-docs-13), and one community comment credits Unreal's third-party and community support (unreal-comm-11). Nothing in the pack describes a large store of ready-made models, tools, or plugins. fab.com appears only as a domain that blocks non-browser clients, with no description of its content. missing for 10: evidence of an official asset marketplace and its catalog size, availability of ready-made models and assets, a distribution channel for third-party plugins, independent hands-on corroboration of ecosystem breadth
